_doc: Round 25 (S25.3, scripts/sim/problems.gd): the small trouble the base throws up. Every number and word of the four kinds lives here; the contract's constants (FIRST_DAY, MAX_OPEN, TTL_H, FIX_REACH, the gap formula) are in the script. `base_s` is rules seconds of the avatar's own hands at the marker before the skill scales it (left = base_s / (speed.base + speed.per_skill x skill), then the title and the traits through traits.mult 'repair'); `scrap` the cost, paid when the work is done (a delegate pays when they begin); `min_skill` the floor for being asked over the radio. `late` is what happens once, past the time. The texts: `raise` is the News line, `where` its second line, `worse` the call at the halfway mark.

gap._doc: the next problem comes gap_h(day) x (from + span x a hash) game hours after this one, then waits for the working day (about 1.5 days between two in all)
